argv:
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
targets=[p/'.blind_write_probe']+[x for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()]
for x in targets:
 try:
  f=x.open('a');f.close()
 except PermissionError:
  continue
 print('WRITE_ALLOWED',x);raise SystemExit(1)
print('all artifact writes denied')
